source_text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
child_paraphrase: Be kind and gentle to each other, and forgive, because God has forgiven you.
license_note: Short quotation of the 1769 Oxford King James Version. That edition is public domain in the United States. No bulk copyrighted Bible text is used.
lock_note: Issue #6 Mission 6 lock: Kindness at the Fall Festival. Ephesians 4:32 is the source-locked kindness verse; no substitute was needed.
forbidden_claims: Do not invent extra narrative as scripture
